appDescription.message: Detect downloadable web video streams and save supported non-DRM media locally.

separateTracksMuxHint.message: Audio and video may be separate tracks and will require local muxing.

showingRelevantResources.message: Showing the $COUNT$ most relevant media resources.

drmUnsupportedFooter.message: DRM-protected or access-restricted media is not supported.

managerSubtitle.message: Inspecting detected HLS, DASH, MSE and range-based media resources.

muxSavedSuccess.message: Video and audio were muxed locally and saved as one MP4 file.

playVideoHint.message: Play the video for a few seconds and reopen the extension if one of the tracks has not appeared yet.

capHlsLive.message: HLS live recording with segment deduplication, retries and streaming disk writes

capMse.message: MSE/fMP4 .m4s and HTTP Range response capture

capReferer.message: Source-page Referer replay for media CDN anti-hotlink checks

capStreamingMux.message: Streaming local MP4 mux with bounded memory usage

capDrmUnsupported.message: DRM or access-control circumvention is intentionally not supported

hlsVodNotRecorder.message: This playlist has ended and is VOD, so live recording is not enabled for it.

liveEndedSaved.message: The live stream ended and the recording was saved.

liveStoppedSaved.message: Recording stopped. Everything recorded so far was saved.

errorFilePickerUnavailable.message: This Chrome version does not expose the File System Access save-file API to the extension page.

errorDirectoryPickerUnavailable.message: This Chrome version does not expose the folder picker API to the extension page.

errorVideoTrackUnusable.message: The selected video URL could not be parsed as a usable video track.

errorAudioTrackUnusable.message: The selected audio URL could not be parsed as a usable audio track.

errorHlsNoVariant.message: The HLS master playlist has no playable variants.

errorHlsNestedMaster.message: Nested HLS master playlists are not supported yet.

errorHlsImplicitByteRange.message: This HLS stream uses an unsupported implicit byte-range offset.

errorHlsNotLive.message: This HLS playlist is not a live stream.

errorHlsEncrypted.message: Encrypted HLS ($METHOD$) is not supported by the live recorder.

errorHlsSeparateAudio.message: This HLS variant uses a separate audio rendition. Separate audio HLS live recording is not supported yet.

errorHlsDiskWrite.message: Failed to write the live recording to disk: $REASON$

errorHlsResumePermission.message: Write access to the previous recording file was not granted.

errorHlsResumeFormatChanged.message: The live stream format changed since the previous recording, so it cannot be resumed into the same file.

errorHlsRemuxUnavailable.message: This recording cannot be finalized to MP4 because its temporary TS file or recording folder is no longer available.

errorHlsRemuxUnsupported.message: The recorded MPEG-TS stream cannot be converted to a playable MP4 in this browser.
